title: Fast Food Restaurant Franchise Opportunity
name: Dumpling Hood, 160 Franchisees, Est'd in 2014, Chandigarh HQ
description: Dumpling Hood is a premier healthy QSR brand founded in 2014 that has rapidly expanded to over 150+ outlets across India. - The brand uniquely differentiates itself by serving dumplings crafted from 100% whole wheat and ragi (millet) wrapper shells with zero preservatives, MSG, or refined flour. - A master franchisee retains a 60% share (INR 5.40 Lakhs) of the standard INR 9 lakh individual franchise fee, as well as 60% of monthly royalties collected within their exclusive territory. - This generous split allows them to fully break even by selling just 56% to 57% of their store potential, while also receiving two free outlets for direct operational profit. - The franchise partners need an FSSAI license to operate. Monthly sales and profit margins: 1) Format 1 – Takeaway: - INR 12 lakh monthly sales: Achievable with an AOV of INR 200 by generating around 200 orders per day, supported by takeaway, delivery, repeat customers, and a high-volume menu. - 40% margin: Supported by the compact format, low rent, only 3 staff, standardized preparation, controlled food costs, and high order volumes, which help keep operating costs low. 2) Format 2 – Dining: - INR 15 lakh monthly sales: Achievable with an AOV of INR 200 by generating around 250 orders per day, combining dine-in, takeaway, and delivery sales, along with upselling through combos, beverages, and add-ons. - 40% margin: Supported by efficient operations with 5 staff, standardized food preparation, controlled costs, and higher sales volume, allowing fixed costs such as rent and salaries to be spread across more orders.
